acceptance.given: The Toolchain subprocess capability implementation and its existing lifecycle tests are available for validation.

oracle.expected: The validated subprocess capability descriptor explicitly contains shell=false.
forbidden: The descriptor omits the shell=false declaration.
oracle.observable: The structured subprocess capability descriptor or validator inspection exposes shell=false as an explicit field.

acceptance.then: The subprocess capability is accepted only when its descriptor explicitly declares shell=false.
acceptance.when: Execute the existing subprocess lifecycle test selector and inspect the descriptor validation assertion.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing stage-lifecycle subprocess descriptor tests and select the assertion that rejects a descriptor whose shell field is absent or true.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require subprocess capability descriptors to carry an explicit shell=false field and reject shell-enabled descriptors.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing descriptor shape and subprocess execution interfaces; rollback only removes the shell=false enforcement change.

slice_hint.state_transition: Subprocess capability lacks a verified shell=false declaration -> descriptor validation explicitly requires shell=false.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted lifecycle test command completes with an observable descriptor check confirming shell is false.
